title: ラ・カンパネラ
chartNote: Hold-heavy, non-repeating full-length draft. Long bell-anchor holds, occasional hold-constrained staircases, adjacent-lane trills, syncopated fragments, broken-arpeggio leaps, and section-by-section contour changes. BPM/offset provisional pending exact audio calibration.

designNotes.holds: Each 32-beat section has a dense set of medium/long hold anchors. Selected holds support a staircase across the other lanes; the remaining holds create sustained tension and release.
designNotes.trills: Alternating bursts on adjacent lanes, with pair, direction, spacing, and start position varied by section.
designNotes.variation: Twenty 32-beat sections use varied contours, positions, and rhythms. No phrase loop, repeated block, or automatic lane rotation.
designNotes.scoring: Each HOLD counts as one chart note and receives its judgement when released at the tail.
